title: Laminations and External Angles for Similarity Pairs
summary: A {\em similarity pair} is the dynamical system in $\mathbb{C}$ generated by two maps $f:z \to sz-1$ and $g:z \to sz+1$ for $|s|<1$. Associated to the dynamical system is an attractor $Λ$. The Barnsley--Harrington Mandelbrot set $\mathcal{M}$ is the set of $s\in \mathbb{D}$ for which $Λ$ is connected. Let $K$ denote the filled set of a connected $Λ$. For $s\in \partial \mathcal{M}$ we show that the (partially defined) action of the semigroup on $\partial K$ is topologically conjugate to a (discontinuous) piecewise linear action of constant slope.
